brief: R114 HERO REACTION SYSTEM + FEATURE REACTION WIRING
ruling: 2026-08-25 owner ruling (R109): external development-stage artwork may be used in the Future Spinner animation pipeline, provided final shipped assets remain quality-controlled, provenance-recorded, and presentation-safe for Stake.
identity_gate: Measured against the LIVE idle rest frame, not against filenames: silhouette IoU 0.9695-0.9932 across every frame of every strip; opaque foot core (alpha>=250) drift 0 px on all four strips; every strip's frame 01 is pixel-identical to its final frame. The package derives all frames from one immutable master whose sha256 matches the R112 crossed-arms master.
ground_glow_note: Soft alpha extends 16-18 px below the feet on win-reaction and energy-up. That is the reactive ground glow, not foot movement: at alpha>=128 the drift is 1 px and at alpha>=250 it is 0 px.

refused.02-attention-glance: Moderate motion: 31.9% peak change against the win reaction's 57.1%. The package's own QA calls it "intentionally subtle" and suggests holding frames to compensate. The brief says skip rather than ship distraction, and it would have cost a further ~1.5 MB.
refused.04-crossed-arms-idle-b: WEAKER than the idle already shipping: 30.4% peak change against the live idle's 59.0% between extremes, and 2.2 source px of head travel against 6.6. Adopting it would regress the idle R112 shipped and the owner approved.

assets.note: R112 sheet re-packed at 70% so every hero sheet shares one resolution. Mixing scales would change the hero's sharpness at the cut into a reaction. Measured at true display size (1221 device px tall) a 70% source renders at 99.5% of full sharpness with a mean pixel difference of 2.42 of 255.

assets.role: one-shot win acknowledgement: chest lift, visor powers magenta to cyan, reactive ground glow, returns to exact rest
assets.exit_smoothness: the duplicate final frame is kept deliberately: it differs from the live idle rest by 36.2% of the figure against 48.3% for the frame before it, and a normal step inside the idle loop is 36.5-47.9%

assets.role: one-shot feature / Overdrive entry response, gentler than the win reaction
